description: Generic SDMX data fetch from any ECB flow. Key is dot-separated dimension values; empty positions are wildcards. Example: flow_ref="EXR", key="D.USD.EUR.SP00.A" (daily USD/EUR spot). Euro-area government bond yields by country, 10-year, MONTHLY average (not a daily quote): flow_ref="IRS", key="M.<ISO2>.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z" with IT = Italy BTP, FR = France OAT, ES = Spain, PT = Portugal, GR = Greece, DE = Germany (e.g. key "M.IT.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z", last_n 3).

flow_ref.description: Flow reference, EXR (exchange rates), ICP (HICP), BSI, IRS, STS, BLS, MIR, ...

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations

name: ecb_get_data
title: Ecb Get Data
